name: Poisonous Snake
otherStatistics: Blindsight 10 ft. Passive Perception 10. No listed skills or languages.
appearance: A slender, coral-snake-like reptile with a small black head and narrow bands of muted red, charcoal and cream.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Basic Rules (2018), D&D Basic Rules v1.0, November 2018, and printed p. 149.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit and 5-ft. reach against one target. A hit deals 1 piercing damage and prompts a DC 10 Constitution save. The target takes 5 (2d4) poison damage on a failure, or half on a success.

name: Polar Bear
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +3. Passive Perception 13. No listed special senses or languages.
appearance: A heavy white-furred bear with a long neck, a tapering head, rounded ears, a black nose and broad paws.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Basic Rules (2018), D&D Basic Rules v1.0, November 2018, and printed p. 149.
sections.Traits: Keen Smell. The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit and 5-ft. reach against one target. A hit deals 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit and 5-ft. reach against one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +1. Passive Perception 11. No listed special senses or languages.
